t: This is Panton Street, a short street in Westminster running from Haymarket in the west to Leicester Square in the east. It's named after Thomas Panton, a gambler and property speculator who died in 1685. The story goes that after substantial winnings he retired from games of chance and developed the area. So the street you're standing on grew from a gambler's winnings, turned into bricks and mortar in the middle of what is now theatreland.
